title: Machi Koro-style round tower category icon spec
purpose: Small circular major-establishment badge placed immediately before the IT company card title.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset for card compositing.
integration_context.composition: one centered circular badge filling most of the square canvas

icon_color.description: Dark purple sampled from the unobstructed footer of backgrounds/purple.png.

subject.default: profile silhouette of a slender observation tower topped by a sphere
subject.description: A white pictogram matching the recognizable tower-with-sphere visual language of the original Machi Koro major-establishment symbol.

pictogram.subject: slender tower in side profile with one large sphere near the top
pictogram.description: A bold white silhouette of a narrow modern observation or broadcast tower. Use a tapering vertical shaft, a single prominent round sphere near the upper portion, and a short pointed or antenna-like cap above it. The silhouette should evoke a Shanghai-style tower profile and the original Machi Koro purple category icon while staying extremely simple.
pictogram.shape_language: very simple, chunky, geometric, slightly rounded
pictogram.line_rule: Use a solid white silhouette with no thin strokes and no internal decoration.

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.small_size_priority: instantly recognizable beside a card title

anti_patterns: do not omit the dark-purple round badge
do not add an outer ring
do not draw a cluster of towers or a skyline
do not use realistic rendering, gradients, highlights, bevels, texture, or shadows
do not add letters, numbers, logos, or any text
do not add card furniture or scenery
do not use thin or intricate strokes
do not leave transparency holes inside the purple circle

current_icon.subject: white tower profile with sphere
current_icon.expected_result: A dark-purple solid circle with a simple bold white profile of a slender tower topped by a sphere, on a genuinely transparent canvas.

final_prompt_summary: Generate only a small Machi Koro-style category badge on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Make one perfect solid circle in #3E1F59 filling about 85% of the canvas, with no outer ring. Center a bold pure-white silhouette of a slender tower in side profile: a tapering vertical shaft, one prominent round sphere near the upper portion, and a short pointed antenna-like cap above it. The pictogram should evoke the recognizable Shanghai-style tower-with-sphere symbol used for purple major establishments in the original Machi Koro visual language, while remaining extremely simple, chunky, and legible. The white tower should fill about 54% of the circle. Flat two-color vector-style artwork only: no text, letters, numbers, logo lettering, border, shading, gradient, texture, shadow, 3D effect, scenery, or background. Preserve genuine transparency outside the circle and solid opacity inside it.
